dedupe_keys.name: transmission and distribution substation energy management considering large scale energy storage demand side management and security constrained unit commitment

description: Hossein Jokar and colleagues publish two Excel input workbooks for transmission-market and distribution-substation energy management. The July 2022 Zenodo deposit lists six-bus and 118-bus cases, freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. The associated IEEE Access study couples security-constrained unit commitment with demand-side management and large-scale storage charging, using a single-level reformulation of a bilevel optimisation problem. These are standard benchmark systems, not a documented real geographic network. The inputs can support reproduction or comparison of storage-dispatch and commitment simulations. Detailed worksheet fields, units and time horizon are not described on the repository page and must be reconciled with the paper. No executable solver code is listed. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these study workbooks. Their completeness and the paper’s computation-time claims were not independently tested.
